# Trends Incoming

> Fast, fact-checked guide to upcoming US trends, releases, events and deadlines. Owned and operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC (Florida LLC). Every page cites its sources.

- [GTA 6 release date: November 19, 2026 (preload Nov 12)](https://joshuaofisrael.github.io/trendsincoming/games/gta-6-release-date/): Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S for $79.99. Preload starts Nov 12.
- [2027 Grammy nominations: announced Monday, Nov 16, 2026](https://joshuaofisrael.github.io/trendsincoming/music/grammy-nominations-2027/): Key dates for the 2027 Grammys: nominations Nov 16, 2026; show Feb 7, 2027 on ABC, Disney+ and Hulu.
- [Where to watch the NBA in 2026-27: NBC, Peacock, ESPN, ABC, Prime Video](https://joshuaofisrael.github.io/trendsincoming/sports/nba-where-to-watch-2026-27/): 2026-27 NBA where-to-watch guide: opening night Oct 20 on NBC/Peacock, plus the weekly national TV and streaming schedule.
- [Where to watch the NHL in 2026-27: ESPN, ABC, TNT, ESPN+, NHL Power Play](https://joshuaofisrael.github.io/trendsincoming/sports/nhl-where-to-watch-2026-27/): 2026-27 NHL where-to-watch guide: ESPN/ABC, TNT, ESPN+/Disney+/Hulu, NHL Power Play, plus marquee dates.
- [ACA open enrollment 2027: Nov 1, 2026 to Jan 15, 2027 key dates](https://joshuaofisrael.github.io/trendsincoming/money/open-enrollment-2027/): HealthCare.gov open enrollment for 2027 coverage runs Nov 1, 2026 to Jan 15, 2027. Enroll by Dec 15 for Jan 1 coverage.
